routes.name: Residencia Temporal – Personas que realizan actividades lícitas remuneradas
Residencia Temporal – Principio de reciprocidad internacional (Mercosur)

note: Chile, read on the National Migration Service's (SERMIG) own pages on 2026-10-30 (the fee table updated 1 October 2026). Temporary residence lasts up to 2 years and every subcategory may be extended by two years in succession (seasonal workers and one other excepted); it is applied for on SERMIG's digital portal, from abroad (the holder then has 90 days to enter) or in Chile. A performer's subcategory is the one for lawful paid activities (formerly 'subject to contract'); the Mercosur reciprocity subcategory is the free movement route for the Residence Agreement's nationals (Bolivians may use their national identity card). The work each allows is read as any lawful paid activity, which is what the subcategory names; neither page ties it to an employer. Temporary residence fees are set by nationality on a separate table and aren't written. Permanent residence (Residencia Definitiva) lets its holder live indefinitely and carry on any lawful activity, asked for by a holder of a temporary residence whose subcategory allows it, within 90 days before it expires; it costs CLP 142,726. How many years of temporary residence must come first, and which count toward naturalisation, aren't on these pages and aren't written.

sources.title: SERMIG, Residencia Temporal
sources.said: La Residencia Temporal es el permiso otorgado por el Servicio Nacional de Migraciones (SERMIG) a las personas extranjeras que tengan el propósito de establecerse en Chile por un tiempo limitado , cuya vigencia será hasta de 2 años ... Personas que realizan actividades lícitas remuneradas ... Principio de reciprocidad internacional (Mercosur) ... Todas las subcategorías podrán ser prorrogadas por dos años de manera sucesiva ... Las personas titulares de Residencias Temporales otorgadas fuera de Chile dispondrán de un plazo de hasta 90 días corridos para ingresar al país.

sources.title: SERMIG, Residencia Definitiva
sources.said: La Residencia Definitiva es el permiso otorgado por el Servicio Nacional de Migraciones (SERMIG) a las personas extranjeras que tengan Residencia Temporal vigente, para residir indefinidamente y desarrollar cualquier actividad lícita en el país.
